children: Presentation to highlight Nanjing Phase II ramp-up and lower unit production costs, an approximately US$96 million Indian order and AI data center validation progress

(“CBAK Energy” or the “Company”), a leading China-based lithium-ion battery manufacturer and energy solutions provider, today announced that its Chief Financial Officer, Jiewei Li, will present at the October 2026 Emerging Growth Virtual Equity Conference, hosted by Noble Capital Markets, on October 1, 2026. The presentation will highlight the completed ramp-up of the Company’s Nanjing Phase II facility and the associated decline in unit production costs, growth in Model 32140 cell shipments, the approximately US$96 million Indian customer order, progress in customer validation of its full-tab 26650 lithium iron phosphate (“LFP”) cells for battery backup unit (“BBU”) and uninterruptible power supply (“UPS”) applications in AI data centers, and first-quarter 2026 revenue growth.

Mr. Li will deliver a corporate presentation and participate in a live Q&A session. The conference will also offer scheduled one-on-one meetings with qualified investors. Investors are encouraged to register in advance and visit the conference website for the latest agenda, meeting availability and event updates.

Manufacturing Expansion and Lower Unit Costs:

CBAK Energy completed the ramp-up of its Nanjing Phase II facility in August 2026. As previously disclosed, unit production costs have declined following completion of the ramp-up. Shipments of the Company’s Model 32140 cells reached approximately 32.55 million units during the first seven months of 2026, up 101.5% year over year and approximately 8.6% above full-year 2025 shipment volume. Daily production capacity at the Nanjing Phase II facility reached approximately 177,800 cells in July 2026, up 174.0% from January 2026.

In August 2026, the Company secured a battery cell order from one of India’s leading two- and three-wheeler manufacturers, with an estimated value of approximately US$96 million, excluding applicable taxes. The Company expects to complete deliveries in 2027, and the order is expected to bring the designated manufacturing facility to full capacity utilization. The Company is also in advanced discussions with another prospective customer that ranks among India’s five largest two- and three-wheeler manufacturers regarding a potentially sizable order for the same cell model.
AI Data Center Validation Advances to Module Level:

The Company’s 26650 HP V2.0 and 26650 PFS2 V2.0 full-tab LFP cells, developed for BBU and UPS applications in AI data centers, continue to undergo customer testing and validation. Multiple prospective customers have advanced to module-level validation. Under specified internal test conditions, the cells recorded internal resistance below 3 mΩ and achieved maximum discharge power of approximately 260 W and 310 W, respectively.

First-quarter 2026 unaudited net revenues increased 99.3% year over year to US$69.62 million, and net revenues from light electric vehicle applications increased 441.6% year over year to US$15.41 million.

is a leading China-based high-tech company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of high-power lithium-ion and sodium-ion batteries, as well as materials used in the manufacture of high-power lithium-ion batteries. The Company’s battery cell production, research and development, and sales operations are located in Nanjing, Dalian and Shangqiu. The Company also operates battery cell research and development centers in both Nanjing and Dalian. Its raw materials operations, including production, research and development, and sales, are headquartered in Shaoxing. The Company’s products and solutions serve electric vehicles, light electric vehicles, energy storage systems and other high-power applications. In January 2006, CBAK Energy became the first Chinese lithium battery manufacturer to be listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market.

Established in 1984, Noble Capital Markets is an SEC- and FINRA-registered full-service investment bank and advisory firm serving public and private middle-market companies and investors. The firm provides investment banking, equity research, corporate access, and institutional sales and trading services.
